content: {"praised":["Judi Dench and Cate Blanchett deliver outstanding performances.","Richard Eyre's direction creates a riveting, emotionally moving experience.","Story and character development are well done and engaging.","Themes of obsession and moral dilemmas are compelling.","The film stands out among summer releases."],"criticized":["Film is dark, trashy, and depressing.","Lacks entertaining thriller elements, feels dull.","Main characters have no redeeming qualities, unlikable.","Story feels familiar and unoriginal.","Tone is too bleak, leaves viewers dissatisfied."]}
